Fujibo Holdings.why: Fujibo's mainstay Polishing Pad Business makes CMP polishing pads for semiconductor devices and polishing pads for silicon wafers; it is the company's largest segment by sales and profit, so foundry wafer starts drive its stock.
Fujibo Holdings.evidence: FY2025 results presentation (05-18-2026): 'In Polishing Pad as a core business, expanded sales of CMP pads for semiconductor'

players.product: Polishing pads for semiconductor devices (CMP pads) and for silicon wafers (Polishing Pad Business)

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujibo Holdings results presentation: FY2025 Financial Results (05-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (fiscal year ended March 2026) Polishing Pad Business: net sales JPY 22,561 million (FY24: JPY 19,307 million) and operating profit JPY 6,385 million (FY24: JPY 4,729 million). CMP applications: increasing demand for advanced logic semiconductors due to the rapid uptake of generative AI; silicon wafer applications secured a certain level of sales on strong demand for advanced product applications; hard disk demand for data center applications continued.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 22,561 million segment net sales; JPY 6,385 million segment operating profit

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujibo Holdings results presentation: FY2025 Financial Results (05-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Under the 'Zokyo 21-25' plan (FY2021-2025) the company invested JPY 11.4 billion of capex in the Polishing Pad Business (target JPY 6.5 billion) and says it expanded sales of CMP pads for semiconductors through a solution-based business model.
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 11.4 billion Polishing Pad capex FY2021-2025

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujibo Holdings results presentation: FY2025 Financial Results (05-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 Polishing Pad key measures (management): expand existing fields, especially advanced semiconductors (CMP, silicon wafers, hard disks); ramp up entry into hard pads; pursue pricing aligned with added value; improve productivity in response to growing demand; enhance R&D and expand production capacity for the growing market. Management expects the expansion trend in AI-related investment to continue, with business performance remaining firm.

quarterly_data.quarter: Fujibo Holdings results presentation: FY2025 Financial Results (05-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Middle East impact (management, May 2026): no change in customer demand so far; raw materials and fuel can be secured for the moment; due to timing differences in passing price increases on to customers, Polishing Pad operating profit is expected to decline by approximately 5%.
